name: amiganxengine
notes: NXEngine-evo for AmigaOS 3.2 and GFOS on 68040/68060 with FPU, GFOpenGPU SDL2 and AHI. Cave Story and Boss Rush have separate GlowIcons and share a 320x240 engine. Includes the native Installer, ReadMe, corresponding GPLv3 source and third-party codec notices. Game data is downloaded separately.
